explication: OpenSearch is a distributed search and observability engine. A typical client submits a request through the high-level REST client and HTTP transport to a cluster, where search services execute queries and optional search pipelines shape processing. Indexing can pass through ingest pipelines before reaching shard engines; streaming ingestion adds poller state management and cluster metadata coordination. The tree and excerpts support these core areas, REST client layers, PPL query service, and cloud repository integrations. Many server links are inferred from component roles; unsampled wiring is not expanded.
